name: UnternehmerTUM Incubator
notes: Munich, Germany. Incubator portfolio with team names, product descriptions and links.

name: KIT-Gründerschmiede founding teams
notes: Karlsruhe, Germany. Directory of teams advised by KIT, with industry, topic and development-phase filters.

name: Freie Universität Berlin incubation projects
notes: Berlin, Germany. Profund Innovation describes selected projects in incubation. Review each project’s own entry for evidence of grants.

name: Humboldt-Innovation startup portfolio
notes: Berlin, Germany. Portfolio of startups supported by the Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin transfer organisation.

name: Startup Port startup stories
notes: Hamburg metropolitan region, Germany. Public profiles from the regional university and research network include business ideas, sectors and, for some teams, founding years.

name: dresden|exists founder portraits
notes: Dresden, Germany. Founder interviews from Dresden’s university and research startup service, with dated links to individual stories.

name: RWTH Aachen Spin-off Award
notes: Aachen, Germany. The November 2026 demo-day report identifies the second round of Spin-off Award recipients and describes each team’s work.

name: University of Cologne Gateway startup portfolio
notes: Cologne, Germany. Gateway’s startup directory links to profiles explaining what each venture offers.

name: TU Darmstadt HIGHEST startups
notes: Darmstadt, Germany. HIGHEST profiles ventures supported at TU Darmstadt and at other universities in the region. Check the individual entry for its affiliation.

name: Leipzig University SMILE
notes: Leipzig, Germany. SMILE presents selected startups by sector, with descriptions of their products or services.

name: University of Potsdam startup projects
notes: Potsdam, Germany. Potsdam Transfer describes university startup projects and links to project and company sites where available.

name: University of Bonn enaCom
notes: Bonn, Germany. The university transfer centre publishes examples of ventures across departments, including established alumni companies.

name: Heidelberg University founding examples
notes: Heidelberg, Germany. University profiles describe selected startups and spin-offs and give a startup year for individual entries.

name: BRIDGE Bremen startup gallery
notes: Bremen, Germany. Bremen’s university startup network lists ventures, websites and sector or programme tags.

name: University of Stuttgart TRACES Entrepreneurship
notes: Stuttgart, Germany. The university transfer centre describes its startup programmes, funding guidance and support for research spin-offs.

name: ETH Zurich spin-offs and startups
notes: Zurich, Switzerland. ETH Entrepreneurship publishes its university venture reports and an overview of ventures awarded an ETH label.

name: YES!Delft
notes: Delft, Netherlands. The incubator names participating startups and publishes programme news and founder stories.

name: Aalto Startup Center alumni companies
notes: Espoo, Finland. The startup centre links to a list of selected companies that have completed its programmes.

name: EPFL startups in creation
notes: Lausanne, Switzerland. EPFL profiles research teams developing ventures through its startup programmes.

name: INiTS Vienna SCALEup
notes: Vienna, Austria. The incubator’s spring 2026 SCALEup cohort page describes participants and its demo day.
